_readme: Definitions for New-ZabbixToolkitScripts.ps1. Each entry becomes a Zabbix manual host-action global script (Alerts > Scripts) that runs a kit script on the selected host and shows the output. Only fast, read-only scripts belong here (they return an answer in a second). Scripts that change the machine are launched detached or pushed via GPO/Intune - see Zabbix-Run-Toolkit-Scripts.md. Add your own by copying an entry. 'script' is the path under C:\Sysadmin-Toolkit; 'args' is optional.

scripts.name: Local admin audit
scripts.description: Who is in the local Administrators group, flagged against the expected list.

scripts.name: Health check
scripts.description: Scored health: disk, memory, services, reboot pending, uptime, updates, Defender.

scripts.name: PC inventory
scripts.description: Full per-PC inventory (hardware, OS, disks, network, installed software).

scripts.name: Certificate expiry
scripts.description: Certificates expiring soon in the machine stores.

scripts.name: Firewall audit
scripts.description: Firewall profiles, inbound allow rules, listening ports; flags risky ports.

scripts.name: Win11 readiness
scripts.description: TPM / Secure Boot / UEFI / CPU / RAM / disk check + Win10 end-of-support countdown.

scripts.name: Network diagnostics
scripts.description: Adapters, gateway, DNS, internet reachability, public IP.

scripts.name: Share permissions
scripts.description: Share + NTFS permissions and orphaned SIDs on this host.

scripts.name: Password expiry (AD)
scripts.description: AD accounts whose passwords expire soon. Run on a DC / RSAT machine.

scripts.name: AD health (DC)
scripts.description: dcdiag + replication + FSMO + SYSVOL, scored. Run on a domain controller.
